easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.tool.dam: Uses durability after a successful harvest
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.pa: Place Farmer’s Delight Rice directly into a Paddy Farmer.
Both Paddy Farmer and Rich Paddy Farmer support Rice.
Rich Paddy Farmer grows Rice faster thanks to Rich Soil.
On Rich Paddy, a Knife is optional for the extra Rice drops from cutting and is not damaged.
Right-click an empty Paddy Farmer with Sand, then add Sugar Cane.
Both Paddy variants support Sugar Cane and it needs no tool.
It grows to three blocks tall; the top two are harvested and the base stays planted.
Rich Soil does not make Sugar Cane grow faster.
Sneak-use the Farmer to dismantle Sugar Cane mode.
Dismantling gives back the Sand and the Sugar Cane currently stored.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.ri: Rich Farmer — Normal Crops
Insert a normal crop or seed supported by Easy Villagers.
Rich Soil makes supported crops grow faster.
A Hoe is optional; Fortune can improve compatible harvests.
Harvesting these crops does not damage the Hoe.
Rich Farmer — Tomatoes & Rope
Insert Tomato Seeds into a Rich Farmer.
Add up to two Ropes to grow extra Tomato sections.
Each section grows on its own, so the Ropes increase how much can be growing at once.
Rich Soil speeds supported Tomato growth; a Hoe is optional for Fortune.
Sneak-use removes the highest Rope first and returns it.
Rich Farmer — Mushroom Colonies
Insert a Red or Brown Mushroom; the Farmer grows the matching Mushroom Colony.
The Colony can finish growing without a Knife.
When it is mature, it waits until a Knife is equipped.
Harvesting gives 3 matching mushrooms and the Colony starts growing again.
The Knife is not damaged by this harvest.
Rich Farmer — Melon
Insert Melon Seeds into the Rich Farmer.
Rich Soil speeds up the stem while it is growing.
Once the stem is ready, the Melon appears at normal speed.
A ready Melon waits for an Axe before it can be harvested.
Fortune and Silk Touch on the Axe work normally.
The Axe loses durability only after a successful harvest.
If the output is full, the Melon waits and the Axe stays safe.
Rich Farmer — Pumpkin
Insert Pumpkin Seeds into the Rich Farmer.
Rich Soil speeds up the stem while it is growing.
Once the stem is ready, the Pumpkin appears at normal speed.
A ready Pumpkin waits for an Axe before it can be harvested.
Axe enchantments work normally when the Pumpkin is harvested.
The Axe loses durability only after a successful harvest.
If the output is full, the Pumpkin waits and the Axe stays safe.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.cu: Requires one Easy Villagers Villager and provides 4 input plus 4 output slots.
Its protected Cutting Tool slot accepts Knives and Axes.
Farmer’s Delight Cutting recipes have priority over Axe fallback actions.
Axe fallback supports stripping, scraping and wax removal.
Processing is serial: one input completes every 10 ticks.
The complete output must fit before input is consumed or the tool is damaged.
The Cutter is also a workstation for Farmer’s Delight Cutting recipes.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.no: Insert one Easy Villagers Villager; the block has no GUI.
Right-click toggles villager vocalizations for your client only.
The preference persists across dimensions, worlds, servers and restarts.
Muted: Lever ON and Redstone visually powered. Enabled: both visually OFF.
Every loaded switch reflects your same local preference; other players can see another state.
The visual toggle emits no real Redstone and observers cannot detect it.
Without a stored Villager, right-click reports that a villager is required.
jade.easyfarmersdelightcompat.wrong_tool: Wrong tool: Knife or Axe required
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.farmer_t: Knife: used for special harvests. Rich Paddy can use one with Rice, and Rich Farmer needs one to harvest mature Mushroom Colonies. These harvests do not damage the Knife.
Hoe: optional in Rich Farmer for normal crops and Tomatoes. Fortune can improve compatible drops, and harvesting does not damage the Hoe.
Axe: required in Rich Farmer for Melons and Pumpkins. Fortune and Silk Touch work normally. The Axe loses durability only when a fruit is actually harvested.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.paddy_ha: Both Paddy Farmers accept Farmer’s Delight Rice. Rich Paddy grows it faster and can optionally use a Knife for the extra Rice drops Farmer’s Delight gives when cut with a Knife. The Knife is not damaged.
Place Sand in an empty Paddy Farmer, then add Sugar Cane. It grows to three blocks tall and automatically harvests the top two. Rich Soil does not speed up Sugar Cane.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.rich_far: Use normal crops supported by Easy Villagers, such as Wheat, Carrots, Potatoes or Beetroot. Rich Soil speeds them up. A Hoe is optional and can apply Fortune.
Insert Tomato Seeds. You can add up to two Ropes to grow extra Tomato sections. Rich Soil speeds supported growth, and a Hoe is optional for Fortune.

Insert a Red or Brown Mushroom. Rich Farmer grows the matching Mushroom Colony. When it matures, it waits for a Knife, harvests 3 matching mushrooms, then starts growing again. The Knife is not damaged.
Insert Melon Seeds. Rich Soil speeds stem growth. When a Melon is ready it waits for an Axe; Fortune and Silk Touch work normally, and durability is used only after a successful harvest.
Insert Pumpkin Seeds. Rich Soil speeds stem growth. When a Pumpkin is ready it waits for an Axe; Axe enchantments work normally, and durability is used only after a successful harvest.

easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.ri: Rich Farmer — Attached Crops
Install up to two compatible host logs in the Rich Farmer.
Each host has four independent faces: north, south, east and west.
Cocoa Beans on Jungle logs are the vanilla reference mapping.
Additional pod crops can be supplied by data definitions without new gameplay code.
Shift-right-click dismantles upper crops, upper log, lower crops, then lower log.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.at: Plant %s on one of the compatible host logs shown above.
Each installed log provides four independent N/S/E/W face positions.
Up to two compatible host logs can be installed at once.
Growth, harvest reset, loot, Rich Soil and tool rules come from the loaded data definition.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.re: %s remains planted after harvesting instead of being destroyed and replanted.
The loaded definition harvests at age %s and returns the crop to age %s.
A full output makes the mature crop wait safely until inventory space changes.
Rich Soil may accelerate growth only when the loaded definition allows it; it never changes the harvest roll.

easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.farmer_t: Shears: required to harvest mature Orchards. They lose durability only after a successful fruit harvest, and Unbreaking applies normally.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.or: Place a Grafting Support in the world and add any leaves block. Non-productive leaves remain purely decorative.
Oak Leaves and Dark Oak Leaves above Rich Soil become an Apple Orchard and develop fruit through four stages.
Without Rich Soil below, leaves stay decorative and neither age nor produce fruit.
Right-click mature fruit with Shears to harvest it manually. Unbreaking applies normally.
Left-click removes and returns the canopy first, leaving the support in place for reuse.
Installed inside a Rich Farmer, the same system uses Rich Soil and automatically harvests when Shears are available.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.cr: With Croptopia installed, its 26 productive fruit leaves can be grafted onto a placed support or into a Rich Farmer.
Above Rich Soil they follow Croptopia’s real four stages: bud, flower, unripe fruit and ripe fruit.
Without Rich Soil they remain decorative; inside a Rich Farmer growth and harvesting are automated.
On a placed support, ripe fruit requires Shears and right-click; durability is spent only after a successful harvest.
Left-click removes the canopy first so the same support can be reused with different leaves.
easyfarmersdelightcompat.viewer.guide.ci: Croptopia Cinnamon Logs and Cinnamon Wood can be stripped in the Cutter with an Axe.
Each successful operation returns the matching stripped block and one Cinnamon, matching Croptopia’s bark-stripping behavior.
Both outputs must fit before the Cutter consumes the wood or damages the Axe.
